description: Which chains each tool family reaches. aapiChains is where the indexer tools work (getAccountBalance, getWalletActivity, getNFTs, getTokenHolders, getTokenPrice, getTokenPriceHistory); call this before one of them on an unfamiliar chain. suiChains are answered over gRPC, by the sui* tools and the generic tools the reply's suiNote names. Raw-RPC tools (getTransaction, getLogs, getBlock) and rpcCall are not limited to these lists: they take any rpc.ankr.com/<chain> slug, 200+ chains. Each reply reports how it was shaped in _meta.tier and _meta.tier_source.
name: listChains
title: List supported chains
